title: anthurium amoenum var. humile
intro: Anthurium amoenum var. humile, commonly known as the Small-Flowered Anthurium, is a species of flowering plant in the Arum family (Araceae). This plant is valued for its air-purifying properties and health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting better sleep, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Anthurium amoenum var. humile are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. However, the specific bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, and further research is needed to confirm its therapeutic potential.
